about: PDF extraction eval set (scripts/nvidia-pdf-extraction-eval.mjs). Three CC BY 4.0 arXiv papers pinned by version and sha1, plus an image-only copy of one built by the script to stand in for a scanned upload. Every answer was read off the rendered page image by a person, never taken from either extractor. Grading: 'number' passes when the reply contains a number within tol of value; 'match' passes when the reply matches the regex (case-insensitive).
